column5: Two people. Same day. Same starting line.
Same age. Same city. Same zero dollars.
One of them grabs the phone.
The other one grabs a book.
Day one? Nobody can tell the difference.
Day one hundred. Exactly the same.
One percent better every day looks like nothing...
One percent better every day, for one year? Thirty seven times better!
One percent worse every day? You end up with almost nothing.
Same start. Different habits. Completely different life.
So stop waiting. Your day one is today!
